segments.sn22.145:1.2: “Yo, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.145:1.4: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.145:1.5: Vedanā anattā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ anattā;
segments.sn22.145:1.9: Yo, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.

lines: 136-149. Kukkuḷavaggassa paṭhame kukkuḷanti santattaṃ ādittaṃ chārikarāsiṃ viya mahāpariḷāhaṃ.
Imasmiṃ sutte dukkhalakkhaṇaṃ kathitaṃ, sesesu aniccalakkhaṇādīni.

136-149. Anto aggi mahanto chārikarāsi, tattha ukkuḷavikulato akkamantaṃ yāva kesaggaṃ anudahatāya kucchitaṃ kuḷanti kukkuḷaṃ, rūpavedanādi pana tatopi kañci kālaṃ anudahanato mahāpariḷāhanaṭṭhena ca kukkuḷaṃ viyāti kukkuḷaṃ.
